description: A small library that lends books to its members.
data: books with title, author, ISBN (unique) and whether the book is available
members with full name and email (unique)
loans of a book to a member with a due date and whether it has been returned
actions: librarians see all members and all loans
rules: a book can only be lent to one member at a time
a member can have at most 3 books at a time
the due date cannot be in the past
a book that is on loan cannot be removed
